[[File:Bray Zenn.png|thumb|250px|Bray Zenn]] '''Bray Zenn''' (Japanese: '''ガサッツ''' ''Gasattsu'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN050|A Pinch of This, a Pinch of That!]]''. He works alongside [[Cara Liss]]. Bray first encountered {{Ash}}, [[Goh]], and [[Chloe]] when they arrived in the [[Wild Area]], having been sent by the [[curator]] of the [[Pewter Museum of Science]] to research the [[Fossil|Fossil Pokémon]] of the [[Galar]] [[region]]. He apologized after his {{p|Mudsdale}} accidentally sent a large rock at them, which nearly hit Chloe and her {{TP|Chloe|Eevee}}. Bray gave Chloe tools to work with, and she was soon able to find the components of a fossil and put them into a machine. After preparing the lunch, the Fossils were restored and turned out to be a {{AP|Dracovish}} and {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Arctozolt}}, which were caught by Ash and Goh, respectively. ==Pokémon== ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Bray Zenn |pkmn=Mudsdale |type1=Ground |img=Bray Zenn Mudsdale.png |epnum=JN050 |epname=A Pinch of This, a Pinch of That! |vajp= |desc={{p|Mudsdale}} is Bray's only known Pokémon. It accidentally sent a large rock flying towards {{Ash}}, [[Goh]], and [[Chloe]], which was destroyed when {{AP|Pikachu}} used {{m|Iron Tail}} on it. Bray quickly apologized for Mudsdale's actions. Mudsdale's only known move is {{m|Double Kick}}.}} ===Restored=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Goh |pkmn=Arctozolt |type1=Electric |type2=Ice |stage1=Fossilized Bird and Dino |img=Fossilized {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Bird|1=Dino}} anime.png |cap=Fossilized {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Bird|1=Dino}} |img2=Goh Arctozolt.png |epnum=JN050 |epname=A Pinch of This, a Pinch of That! |vajp= |vaen=List of English voice actors{{!}}Kellen Goff |desc={{p|Arctozolt}} was restored by Bray Zenn by fusing together the [[Fossilized Bird]] and [[Fossilized Dino]], although he originally intended to restore {{p|Dracozolt}}. After seeing how Arctozolt came to like [[Goh]], Bray Zenn allowed him to capture it.
